_comment: Copy to operator.config.json (gitignored) and edit. caps.run_minutes is enforced by the wrapper as a wall-clock timeout; the other caps are instructions the prompt follows. Folder names are not configurable: they are constants at the top of each script in .claude/scripts/ and in the prompt.

backup._comment: When true, run-operator.sh (not the agent) commits exactly the files the run changed and pushes HEAD to refs/heads/<branch> on <remote>, after the agent has exited. The remote must be private. Leave false until you have verified a run by hand.
